340		// that region will redeem the code — the apex serves no token endpoint —
341		// so the exchange has to follow it, once the host clears adoptIssuer.

366		}

368		// Record the login in the shared contexts.json credential model — the
369		// single store every consumer (control plane, data API, git remote
370		// helper, entiredb's CLIs) resolves against.
371		if _, err := auth.RecordLoginContext(token, refreshToken, true); err != nil {
372			return fmt.Errorf("save login: %w", withHeadlessStoreHint(err))
373		}

383	// so it's worth one line of confirmation. Falls back to the plain message
384	// when the claims don't parse; validateReceivedToken has already accepted
385	// the token by this point, so this is display only.
386	func loginCompleteLine(token, dialled string) string {

402	// would be nonsense) and for failures the file store wouldn't help with.

113	func NormalizeOriginURL(raw string) string {

118		}

130		case dropPort:

132		case strings.Contains(hostname, ":"):

134		default:

143	// before the lib's stricter origin-only validator runs.

232		case errors.Is(err, deviceflow.ErrAuthorizationPending):
233			code = "authorization_pending"
234		case errors.Is(err, deviceflow.ErrSlowDown):
235			code = "slow_down"
236		case errors.Is(err, deviceflow.ErrAccessDenied):
237			code = "access_denied"
238		case errors.Is(err, deviceflow.ErrExpiredToken):
239			code = "expired_token"
240		case errors.Is(err, deviceflow.ErrInvalidGrant):
241			code = "invalid_grant"
242		default:
243			// Unknown but legitimate OAuth codes come back from
244			// deviceflow.errCodeToSentinel as fmt.Errorf("oauth error: %s",

246			// when the server supplied error_description.
247			const oauthPrefix = "oauth error: "
248			rest, hadPrefix := strings.CutPrefix(err.Error(), oauthPrefix)
249			if !hadPrefix {
250				return "", "", false
251			}
252			if c, d, hasDesc := strings.Cut(rest, ": "); hasDesc {
253				return c, d, true
254			}

267	func descriptionFromSentinelError(err error, code string) string {
268		msg := err.Error()
269		prefix := code + ": "
270		if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(msg, prefix); ok {
